description:
This map displays a coastal urban area using false-colour infrared satellite imagery, where vegetated areas appear bright red/magenta, built-up areas are grey/cyan, and water bodies are dark blue/black. Several land cover polygons are delineated with thin green lines and labelled with numeric codes.
The map shows:
*   Areas labelled `1110` in bright green, indicating general urban fabric or built-up areas. These areas are densely developed.
*   A large, distinct polygon outlined in light blue (cyan) and labelled `1400` in magenta. This area appears intensely red, signifying dense vegetation, consistent with a green urban area or sports and leisure facilities such as a golf course, as indicated by the surrounding document context.
*   Areas labelled `8420` in bright green, corresponding to the surrounding water bodies.
No scale bar, compass, or explicit data source or year are visible. The imagery and labels are consistent with the Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS) Land Use / Land Cover (LULC) nomenclature guidelines.
